reason: A Windows computer-use toolkit that lets a text-only agent observe desktop UI, control applications through UI Automation and input events, capture screenshots, and optionally use a configured vision API.

summaries.zh: 为文本智能体提供 Windows 桌面观察、应用控制、截图识别和输入操作能力的计算机使用工具包。
summaries.en: A Windows computer-use toolkit that enables text-based agents to observe desktop interfaces, control applications, capture screenshots, and use a configured vision API.

capabilities: Observes Windows desktop windows and UI Automation trees
Captures screenshots and sends images to a configured vision API
Clicks, types text, presses keys, scrolls, and drags on desktop applications
Launches applications and waits for UI elements
Provides PowerShell and Rust execution backends with a terminal configuration console
